indication_area: Major depressive disorder; diabetic peripheral neuropathic pain; generalized anxiety disorder; fibromyalgia; chronic musculoskeletal pain
geography: Worldwide (Lilly's worldwide product revenue line; in Forms 10-Q/10-K the Total column, U.S. plus outside U.S.)

approval_evidence.quote: CYMBALTA DULOXETINE HYDROCHLORIDE ... CAPSULE, DELAYED REL PELLETS;ORAL ... 08/03/2004 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity

launch_evidence.quote: Cymbalta was launched in the U.S. in late August 2004 for treatment of depression and in September 2004 for the treatment of diabetic peripheral neuropathic pain.

series_start_reason: Series starts 2004Q3, the launch quarter; 2004Q3 and 2004Q4 are the figures printed in the narrative of the releases that report them (the product table adds a Cymbalta row from 2005Q1).
series_end_reason: Lilly's sec.gov filings print a Cymbalta revenue line through the FY2022 Form 10-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59478/000005947823000082/lly-20221231.htm: 'Cymbalta | 33.7 | 249.6 | 283.3 | 581.5'). The Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2023 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59478/000005947823000162/lly-20230331.htm) lists under Neuroscience only 'Emgality ® | 108.7 | 45.6 | 154.3' and 'Other neuroscience | 35.8 | 170.4 | 206.2', where the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2022 had printed 'Cymbalta ® | 7.8 | 54.9 | 62.7'; no later 10-Q, 10-K or earnings release on sec.gov prints a Cymbalta revenue row (scan to 2026-10-29). Whether Lilly's website workbook continued the line could not be checked (investor.lilly.com: Access Denied).
search_log: Listed every Eli Lilly (CIK 59478) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. the older 'files' pages (all forms). Earnings releases: every 8-K/8-K/A with item 2.02 from 2001, plus the 2003-2004 releases filed under items 9/12 and the two 2016 releases filed under item 9.01 only (2016-01-28, 2016-04-26), each exhibit resolved from the filing's index.json; plus every 10-Q and 10-K from 2002.

Every HTML table row (and plain-text line for .txt exhibits) whose first cell starts with Baqsimi, Effient, Jaypirca, Portrazza, Reyvow, Strattera or Cymbalta followed by a figure was extracted from all of those documents (scan.py in the work directory); narrative sentences were searched separately where no table row exists.

Each quarter is read from the earnings release that reports it as current (first table row: current quarter, prior-year quarter, then year-to-date); where the release prints no line for the product (no Q1 2006 release was filed on EDGAR; the Q1 2018 release has no product table; releases from 2019 list only selected products), from the Form 10-Q for that quarter (Total column = U.S. + outside U.S.); a fourth quarter with neither is the Form 10-K full year less the third-quarter 10-Q nine-month Total.
Every row was checked offline with verify_staged_manifests.check_row before writing; where a Q4 quote carries a twelve-month figure, the verifier checks the four quarters against it.

Lilly's website Financial Workbooks (investor.lilly.com) could not be checked: the host answers 'Access Denied' to this environment, so whether a workbook continued the product after the last sec.gov quarter is not known.

Cymbalta rows: release narrative for 2004Q3-Q4; release tables 2005Q1-2017Q4 (Form 10-Q for 2006Q1), 2018Q2-Q4, 2020Q1; Forms 10-Q for 2018Q1, 2019Q1-Q3, 2020Q2-Q3, 2021Q1-Q3, 2022Q1-Q3; Q4 of 2019-2022 = Form 10-K full year less third-quarter 10-Q nine months.

2010Q3 is the release figure 825.3; the Form 10-Q for that quarter prints a Total of 806.1 and the 2011Q3 release's prior-year column repeats 825.3. The release figure is kept because the four 2010 quarters then sum to the printed full year 3,480.7.
